general.title: 先定位目标物体，再定位目标容器
general.principle: 对于取放类任务，先搜索并取得目标物体，再前往目标容器执行放置。
general.when_to_apply: 当任务要求把某物体放到某容器/家具上，且初始位置未知时。

general.title: 放置前必须位于目标容器处
general.principle: 执行 put 前，必须已经通过 go to 到达目标容器/家具位置；否则 put 可能无效。
general.when_to_apply: 当已取得目标物体并准备放置时。

general.title: 优先检查常见承载面，再检查封闭容器
general.principle: 搜索目标物体时，优先检查桌子、台面、架子、床、沙发等开放承载面；若未找到，再检查抽屉、柜子等封闭容器。
general.when_to_apply: 当目标物体初始位置未知且房间中有多种家具/容器时。

general.title: 避免无效 examine 与盲目穷举
general.principle: 不要使用 examine 作为搜索动作；若已检查大量容器仍未找到目标，应重新评估可见承载面或目标是否存在，而不是继续盲目穷举。
general.when_to_apply: 当搜索目标物体遇到失败或长时间未找到时。

general.title: 避免重复无效动作
general.principle: 当动作返回“Nothing happens”时，不要重复同一动作；应改变状态（如打开/关闭容器、移动位置、取出物体）后再重试。
general.when_to_apply: 当任何动作返回“Nothing happens”且未改变环境状态时。

general.title: 避免在未确认成功前声明完成
general.principle: 不要输出完成状态或停止行动，直到环境观察确认最终放置动作成功；过早声明完成可能导致任务失败。
general.when_to_apply: 在执行最终放置动作后。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务执行流程
台灯观察.principle: 对于“examine/look at X with/under the desklamp”类任务，先定位目标物体和台灯，若目标可携带则拿起目标，移动到台灯所在位置，然后使用台灯（use desklamp）完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务目标为观察某物体与台灯的关系（examine X with desklamp 或 look at X under desklamp）时。

台灯观察.description: 在台灯观察任务中，不要使用 `examine X with desklamp` 动作，该动作通常返回“Nothing happens”；应改为拿起目标物体后使用 `use desklamp`。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: ALFWorld 环境不支持将台灯作为工具参数传递给 examine 动作，台灯是固定物体，只能通过 use 动作开启。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 若需要观察物体与台灯的关系，先确保目标物体在手中或附近，然后执行 `use desklamp` 开启台灯，而非 `examine X with desklamp`。

台灯观察.description: 台灯是固定在桌面或边桌上的物体，不是可导航的位置；执行 `go to desklamp 1` 会返回“Nothing happens”，应直接在当前台灯所在位置使用 `use desklamp`。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: ALFWorld 中只有家具和容器可作为导航目标，台灯等小物体不能作为 go to 的目标。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 当已经位于台灯所在的家具位置时，直接执行 `use desklamp`，不要尝试 `go to desklamp`。

台灯观察.description: 台灯是固定物体，无法被拿起；执行 `take desklamp 1` 会返回“Nothing happens”，应改为将目标物体带到台灯处或直接使用台灯。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: ALFWorld 中台灯被标记为固定物体，不可携带。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 不要尝试拿起台灯；若目标物体可携带，拿起目标物体并移动到台灯所在位置，然后使用台灯。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place execution loop
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-then-place goals, execute a stable loop: locate the target object, take it, go to a sinkbasin or bathtubbasin, clean it, then go to the destination receptacle, open it if closed, and put the object in/on it.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: Use when the goal is to put a clean object into a specified receptacle and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.description: A clean action can fail with 'Nothing happens' if the agent is not at the sinkbasin or bathtubbasin. If cleaning fails, go to the cleaning receptacle and retry the clean action.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires the agent to be co-located with the cleaning fixture before the clean action is valid.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: After taking the object, explicitly go to sinkbasin 1 or bathtubbasin 1, then issue clean <object> with <fixture>.

清洗后放置.description: If the destination receptacle is closed, open it before attempting to put the clean object in/on it.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: Closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves must be opened before items can be placed inside.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: When arriving at the destination, check whether it is closed; if so, issue open <receptacle>, then put <object> in/on <receptacle>.

加热后放置.title: Heat held object with microwave
加热后放置.principle: For heat-and-place tasks, after locating the target object and the microwave, take the object, go to the microwave, open it if closed, then execute `heat <object> with microwave 1` while holding the object. If the first heat attempt returns 'Nothing happens', take the object out of the microwave and retry `heat <object> with microwave 1` while holding it.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires heating an object and a microwave is available, especially if initial heat attempts fail while the object is inside or on the microwave.

加热后放置.title: Do not assume heating succeeded without confirmation
加热后放置.principle: Only proceed to the placement step after an observation explicitly confirms heating, such as 'You heat the <object> using the microwave 1.' If heating has not been confirmed, continue trying valid heating methods rather than placing the object.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After attempting to heat an object and before placing it at the destination.

加热后放置.title: Move to destination before placing heated object
加热后放置.principle: After successfully heating the object, go to the target receptacle/location, open it if needed, and then execute `put <object> in/on <destination>`. If the put action returns 'Nothing happens', verify current location and move to the destination before retrying.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the object is hot and the goal requires placing it in or on a specific location.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires an open fridge and direct cool action
冷却后放置.principle: To cool an object, first open the fridge, then use the cool action with the fridge while holding the object; do not rely on putting the object into the fridge and taking it out as a substitute for cooling.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the task requires cooling an object and a fridge is available.

冷却后放置.title: Do not assume a cool object is already in the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: If the task requires a cool object, verify the object is actually cooled by using the cool action; merely finding an object in the fridge does not guarantee it is cool, and taking it out without cooling may fail the task.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When searching for a cool object and finding a candidate inside the fridge.

冷却后放置.title: Search efficiently by opening containers and tracking visited locations
冷却后放置.principle: When the target object is not in the first few locations, systematically open and check cabinets, drawers, countertops, and other receptacles, keeping track of which have been checked to avoid redundant loops.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately found and many storage locations exist.

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：先取第一件并暂存，再取第二件并最终放置
双物品放置.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，若一次只能携带一件物品，先找到并拿起第一件目标物品，将其暂存到目标容器或临时容器，再寻找并拿起第二件目标物品，最后将两件物品都放入目标容器。
双物品放置.when_to_apply: 当任务要求将两个同类物品放入同一目标容器，且环境限制一次只能携带一件物品时。

双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，若已持有一件物品，直接尝试 take 第二件同类物品通常会失败并返回“Nothing happens”。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 环境限制一次只能携带一件物品，因此必须先放下或暂存当前物品，才能拿取第二件。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 在拿取第二件物品前，先将第一件物品放入目标容器或临时容器，确保 inventory 为空。

双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，将物品放入 garbagecan 等非目标容器可能导致后续无法取回或任务失败。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 部分容器可能不接受物品，或放入后物品状态改变，导致无法继续完成任务。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 优先将暂存物品放入最终目标容器；若必须临时存放，选择可正常取回的容器，并避免使用 garbagecan 等可能不可逆的容器。

general.title: Search visible surfaces before opening closed containers
general.principle: For object-location tasks, first scan visible surfaces (tables, dressers, beds, countertops, shelves) for the target object before opening drawers, cabinets, or other closed containers.
general.when_to_apply: At the start of a task when the target object has not yet been located.

general.title: Open closed containers before inspecting or taking
general.principle: When a drawer, cabinet, fridge, microwave, or other closed container may hold the target object, open it before attempting to inspect or take an item from it; closed containers cannot be searched directly.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object may be inside a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, or microwave.

general.title: After picking up the target, go directly to the destination and put it there
general.principle: Once the target object is held, navigate to the specified destination receptacle and execute the put action without unnecessary intermediate steps.
general.when_to_apply: Immediately after successfully taking the target object.

general.description: If an action returns 'Nothing happens,' do not repeat the same invalid command; verify the current location and choose a valid reachable receptacle or action instead.
general.why_it_happens: The agent may issue commands for locations or objects that are not currently accessible or valid, causing no state change.
general.how_to_avoid: After a 'Nothing happens' observation, re-check the current location and available objects, then select a different valid action rather than retrying the same command.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务：先定位并携带目标物，再在台灯处开启台灯
台灯观察.principle: 对于“examine/look at X with/under the desklamp”类目标，先找到目标物并拿到手中，再移动到台灯所在位置，最后开启台灯完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 目标要求用台灯观察某物，且目标物不在台灯所在位置时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务：目标物与台灯同处时直接开启台灯
台灯观察.principle: 如果目标物和台灯已经在同一位置，直接使用台灯即可完成观察，无需先拿取目标物。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 到达台灯所在位置后，观察到目标物也在同一表面或容器中。

台灯观察.description: 台灯是固定物体，take desklamp 会返回“Nothing happens”，浪费步骤。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 环境将台灯建模为不可携带的固定设备。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 不要执行 take desklamp；应移动到台灯所在位置并直接 use desklamp。

台灯观察.description: examine X with desklamp 常返回“Nothing happens”，不能完成观察；应改为 use desklamp 或 examine X。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 环境可能不支持“with”工具语法，或台灯不是可持有的工具。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 在台灯处优先使用 use desklamp；若需检查目标物，使用 examine X，而不是 examine X with desklamp。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place workflow for 清洗后放置
清洗后放置.principle: For tasks of the form 'put a clean X in/on Y', first locate X, take it, go to a sinkbasin, clean X with the sinkbasin, then go to the target receptacle Y and put X in/on Y.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal explicitly requires an object to be clean before placement, such as 'put a clean dishsponge in drawer', 'put a clean cup in shelf', or 'clean some egg and put it in diningtable'.

清洗后放置.description: Cleaning attempts can fail with 'Nothing happens' when the Executor is not at a valid sinkbasin or when the target receptacle is not suitable for cleaning. In some episodes, cleaning succeeds only after moving to the sinkbasin and retrying.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The clean action requires the agent to be at a valid cleaning receptacle, typically a sinkbasin, and the object must be held. Some receptacles such as bathtubbasin may not support cleaning for certain objects.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Hold the object, go to a sinkbasin, then clean. If cleaning returns 'Nothing happens', verify the current location and try a different sinkbasin or receptacle. Do not repeatedly attempt the same invalid clean action.

清洗后放置.description: Several failed or budget-exhausted episodes show the Executor repeatedly moving to invalid or already-searched locations, or trying to open closed receptacles without first opening them. This wastes steps and prevents finding the target object.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The environment may return 'Nothing happens' for invalid moves, and the Executor may loop on the same location or command without updating its search strategy.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Track visited receptacles and their contents. If a move returns 'Nothing happens', do not repeat it; verify the current location and choose a different unsearched receptacle. Open closed receptacles before checking them. Prioritize likely object locations based on object type.

加热后放置.title: Heat held object by placing it in an open microwave, then heating
加热后放置.principle: For heat-then-place tasks, first navigate to the microwave, open it, put the held object inside, and then issue the heat command.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires heating an object and the object is currently held in inventory.

加热后放置.description: Attempting to heat an object directly from inventory fails with 'Nothing happens' because the object is not inside the heating appliance.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The heating action requires the target object to be located inside the microwave or on a stoveburner, not in the agent's inventory.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Put the object into the microwave or on a stoveburner before issuing the heat command.

加热后放置.description: Attempting to put an object on a stoveburner that already holds a pot or pan fails with 'Nothing happens'.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: Stoveburners can hold only one object at a time; an occupied burner cannot accept another object.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Check the stoveburner for existing objects; if occupied, remove the existing object or choose an empty stoveburner.

冷却后放置.title: Cool by placing item in open fridge, then retrieve
冷却后放置.principle: To cool an item, first ensure the fridge is open, then put the item inside; after cooling, take it back out before moving to the final destination.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires a cooled item and a fridge is available.

冷却后放置.description: The direct 'cool X with fridge' action often returns 'Nothing happens' unless the item is already inside the fridge; instead, put the item into the open fridge, then take it out.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The cooling mechanic requires the item to be placed inside the fridge receptacle; direct cooling commands may be invalid or ineffective.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Open the fridge, put the item inside, then take it out to obtain a cooled item.

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：先放置第一件再取第二件
双物品放置.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，找到第一件目标物品后，先将其放到目标容器，再寻找并取回第二件目标物品。
双物品放置.when_to_apply: 当任务要求将两件相同类型的物品放入同一目标容器，且已找到并拿起第一件物品时。

双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，若未先移动到目标容器位置就执行放置动作，环境会返回“Nothing happens”，导致动作无效并浪费步骤。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 放置动作要求智能体与目标容器处于同一位置；未移动时放置命令无法生效。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 在执行放置动作前，先确认已通过“go to”到达目标容器位置，再执行“put”命令。

双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，若已持有一件物品，直接尝试拾取第二件物品通常会失败并返回“Nothing happens”。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 智能体通常只能同时持有一件物品，持有状态下无法再拾取另一件。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 在拾取第二件物品前，先将已持有的物品放入目标容器或临时放置点，腾空双手后再拾取。

双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，若已打开多个容器但未找到目标物品，应优先检查已打开容器和可见表面（如台面、架子），避免重复访问已确认无目标物品的位置。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 重复访问已检查位置会浪费动作预算，导致任务因预算耗尽而失败。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 维护已检查位置列表，优先检查未检查的已打开容器和可见表面；若目标物品在可见表面上，直接拾取。
